## Homepage

# Albert Orlando

Senior Full-Stack Engineer. Building Cleanse and agentic developer tools. Founding engineer on Amazon Publisher Cloud. New York.

### Now

Senior Full-Stack Engineer at Agile Defense since January 2026, building full-stack applications for the U.S. Air Force that automate workflows and training procedures inside piloting squadrons. Previously founder and independent engineer from March 2025 to December 2025, building Cleanse, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and developer agents on top of Claude and Gemini.

### Selected Work

Founder & Independent Engineer: self-directed research from March 2025 to December 2025. Founded Cleanse, a share-target app that turns any shared link, post, or video into a source-preserved summarized item; live iPhone alpha, built end-to-end. Built open-source research and developer tooling, including Sparkle and gitingest; shipped Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and agent tooling on top of Claude and Gemini.

Amazon Publisher Services: one of the founding engineers on Amazon Publisher Cloud from August 2022 to March 2025. Helped build it from alpha through GA into a multi-tenant data-collaboration platform for 50+ enterprise partners, each with role-based access, audit trails, and isolated tenant workflows. Shipped the vendor-facing UI, backend services and APIs, AWS Clean Rooms audience-matching workflows with data-quality checks, AWS CDK infrastructure, and on-call rotation holding 99.9% availability.

PebblePost: full-stack engineer from October 2017 to August 2022. Re-architected v2 of the PDM Campaign Manager, the internal tool 800+ brands used daily. Shipped a real-time creative editor, a high-throughput web-beacon ingestion pipeline, and REST APIs powering campaigns that drove up to 167% conversion lift in published case studies.

## Privacy

albeorla.ai is a static personal portfolio. It has no accounts, forms, comments, ads, analytics, tracking pixels, or payment flows.

The site stores two preferences in your browser: a theme preference for the light/dark toggle and a session flag so the entrance animation does not replay on every page view. Both stay in your browser and are not sent to Albert.

The site is hosted on Google Cloud Storage behind Google Cloud CDN. Google may process request metadata to serve the site, prevent abuse, and operate the network. Albert does not use that data for ads, profiling, or cross-site tracking.
